claimLimit: This report separates public source labels, project-authored candidate constraints, structural TCK evidence, and human-review gates.

gates.evidence: All 10 packets cite frozen metadata, but no qualified human has judged whether the metadata is sufficient for every mandatory OAC label.
gates.requiredNext: Two independent qualified reviewers must judge field-level source sufficiency.

gates.evidence: No independent annotation rounds exist; pairwise F1 is not computable.
gates.requiredNext: Measure role/obligation and dependency-edge agreement without exposing prior labels.

gates.evidence: 15 of 15 registered plan mutations are rejected by stable structural and contextual checks; threshold is 90%.
gates.requiredNext: Add independently authored mutations before claiming general fault coverage.

gates.evidence: The v0.2 contextual contract closes the observed SC-008 subject, SC-009 scope, and SC-010 root-Unknown failures. Candidate roles and candidate verdicts agree in all ten development cases, while all required candidate obligation types are covered in only five. These are project-authored hypotheses, not Human Gold.
gates.requiredNext: Adjudicate the five obligation-type gaps or create immutable evidence-backed Profile successors; do not patch labels or case IDs into derivation code.

gates.evidence: SC-001 has two sealed plans with different WorkUnit topology; the compiler-independent verifier, sharing the executable Supplier Profile oracle, returns ACCEPT for both.
gates.requiredNext: Have reviewers determine whether both are organizationally plausible, not merely structurally valid.

gates.evidence: The fixture generator is deterministic over frozen roots and tests compare regenerated digests.
gates.requiredNext: Re-run in an independent clean checkout and implementation.

gates.evidence: Reference, initiator-only, fixed-team, and graph-only runs bind the same ten-case input digest and publish deterministic manifests. Exact candidate-role-set matches are 10, 1, 2, and 0 respectively; these project-authored exploratory labels are not human Gold.
gates.requiredNext: Repeat the frozen comparison after independent human annotation; preserve null and negative findings without tuning against the labels.

nextDecision: Treat v0.2 as a contextual technical MVP, not a validated enterprise Profile. Preserve the five obligation-type gaps, run independent semantics under Spec 003, and require qualified adjudication before changing Profile rules or making superiority claims.
